caveats: All categories are membership-first feasibility screens, without model-quality selection.
Short chains may be native peptides or crystallographic constructs; exact chain-to-chain contacts in multichain complexes still need confirmation. CA 8A contact label only.
Different partner identity signature may reflect additions in a multicomponent complex; conservative two-chain subset is separately saved.
family_id is the all-chain connected-component split unit, not a biological family name. Antibody/immune connected supercomponent can merge biologically different enzymes.
83 uniformly labelled window cohort does not equal all 3063 original-label family OOF records.
